critique.evidence: The headline, supporting sentence, filter/select instruction, active stage, selected vector, observable signals, and “Continue to scored replay” CTA establish a coherent path across all viewports. However, unexplained abbreviations such as “context manip,” “tier,” and vector IDs make the taxonomy presenter-dependent; the desktop vector grid visibly clips its leftmost cards and labels; and the raw JSON panel is dense, horizontally truncated, and competes with the useful summary. The “48 vectors” claim is not reconciled with the visible stage counts. Mobile/tablet navigation also hides destinations behind an understated “More” affordance.
critique.fix: Spell out stage names, show a visible total/count reconciliation, replace the raw JSON with labeled human-readable metadata plus an optional “View JSON” disclosure, and fix the desktop grid clipping. Make the responsive “More” control clearly identifiable as navigation.
